reviews.text:
We moved from the United States to Barcelona in March and brought our four cats with us. So far, we've taken Jasper, our 15-year-old cat, and our 7-year-old ginger cat to TotCat.

From the very first moment, they've treated us and our cats with such kindness. They've always been loving, patient, and careful with them, which is very important to us. One of the things we love most about TotCat is that they specialize exclusively in cats, and that gives us a lot of peace of mind and confidence in the care our cats receive.

We feel very secure leaving our cats' health and well-being in their hands. We'll soon be taking our other two cats too. They're our little furry babies, and we have complete faith in TotCat to take care of them. ❤️🐱
Very good experience, 100% recommended

We are incredibly grateful to this veterinary clinic, and especially to Dr. Alicia, for the care and compassion she showed our family during an incredibly difficult time.

When our kitty began experiencing serious health issues, Dr. Alicia was wonderful with him. She was gentle, tender, patient and genuinely caring. Just as importantly, she treated us with compassion too. When you’re scared and trying to make the best decisions for an animal you love deeply, having a veterinarian who understands that emotional weight makes an enormous difference.

Unfortunately, despite everyone's efforts, we ultimately lost our sweet boy. But we will always be grateful knowing that Dr. Alicia did everything she could for him and helped us navigate an incredibly frightening and heartbreaking situation.

Her kindness also extended far beyond his medical care. She was a tremendous help when we needed to organize between her, our pet sitter, and the emergency clinic where our baby had to be hospitalized. My husband and I were out of the country while this crisis occurred. Dr. Alicia kept in contact with me and constanly communicated clearly.

What stands out most about this clinic is that we never felt like they were simply treating an animal. They understood that they were caring for a deeply loved member of our family—and for the humans who loved him.

Dr. Alicia, thank you for your tenderness with our boy, your patience with us, and everything you did to try to help him. Although our story didn't have the ending we desperately wanted, we will never forget the compassion you showed our family during one of the hardest periods of our lives.

We are incredibly grateful to you. 🤍

I went to this clinic on the recommendation of a friend who has worked there for 19 years—lucky me! Although it's far from home, it was well worth the trip. I was very pleasantly surprised, especially after two negative experiences with another vet who misdiagnosed my other cats (luckily, they haven't been to the vet much). I was very surprised by their reasonable prices; they're more affordable than other specialized cat clinics and veterinary clinics in general. Above all, unlike other clinics I've visited with my other cats, they don't suggest unnecessary tests if they can get a reliable diagnosis with the basic ones, which is much appreciated these days. I'm very happy with the treatment I received from Alicia and especially Alba—they were both very friendly! Thank you so much!
I take my two cats there and I'm really happy with the place, the service, the atmosphere, the care the cats receive—it's incredible.

I'm only talking about the grooming part. We got the blood work done by her regular vet. But you can shave your cat's fur under gas sedation. My cat is 14 years old, and sedating her with an injection isn't advisable. It was a short time; they didn't bathe her or anything, but it was what we needed. Just a shave, that's all. They were quick, and Alba even told us about the state of her teeth. In other words, they gave her a very thorough check-up. In short: if you have an older cat who gets sick in the summer and can't be sedated, here's an option that will keep them cool without side effects.
Thank you so much! :)

Mr. Flow and I want to thank the Tot Cat team, especially Alicia Perez.

Thanks to her excellent practice and meticulous follow-up (including weekly emails), Mr. Flow and I were able to enjoy 1244 days together since he was diagnosed with diabetes. Mr. Flow and I feel that Alicia has been more like an angel, and we have been incredibly fortunate to have her in our lives, granting us her wonderful magic of influencing and altering time.
Eternal gratitude, Alicia ✨🐈
Hello, I have two cats with calicivirus and we don't know what to do. Is there a cure?
They saved our cat Simba when other clinics had given him up for lost. Eternally grateful ❤️

We have been going there for many years. We are very grateful for both the good treatment and the professionalism of the veterinarians. It is a reference center for cat care in Barcelona. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much! :)

We are so happy to have found the TotCat team. Martín is an excellent professional and a wonderful person.

We had to take our cat to another veterinary hospital because they were closed. The service there left much to be desired, so we decided to transfer her to TotCat, where she was being treated. Martín correctly diagnosed her even before seeing her. She arrived in critical condition, and they had to perform an emergency bypass because she had a ureteral obstruction. The operation was a success, but our cat didn't survive; she suffered cardiac arrest after the surgery.

We are eternally grateful for the care she received. Martín treated us with so much kindness during these difficult times. We know our cat passed away in the best hands, surrounded by the love of the team.

TotCat is the best place you can take your cat. They are highly professional and treat both cats and people exceptionally well.

Thanks to Martín and Alba, our cat was able to live longer with us and with a good quality of life. We will definitely see each other again when we expand our family; we only trust in you.
Thank you so much! 😊 …
Thank you so much, Angelo!
I only bought meat for my kitten, but the atmosphere was already great. When I need it, I'll definitely come back here with my girl.

My experience at TotCat has been extremely negative. In my more than 40 years of caring for cats, I have never encountered a service so focused on profit and so little on animal welfare.

Key points:

Unnecessary sedation: They charge for sedation at every appointment, even for calm cats who don't require it. But hey, it's essential for TotCat because they charge you for it ($$$$).

Opaque procedures: For ultrasounds, they keep the cats for hours, and you're not present during the procedure, which raises doubts about the transparency of the results. In other places, the owner witnesses what they do during these procedures and watches the professional on the screen.

Questionable diagnoses: They tried to convince me to have my two cats' canine teeth extracted "preventively," while at the other vet, this was considered crazy and completely unnecessary, given that extracting teeth from healthy cats is nothing more than subjecting them to unnecessary suffering. This seemed to me the cruelest thing about TotCat, and I consider it an abusive practice.

Excessive costs: I spent almost €1,000 on tests of dubious value, and even then, they insisted on frequent and expensive checkups.

Comparison with another veterinarian: When I took my cats to another veterinarian afterward, I received clear and accurate diagnoses, without sedation, and with results that contradicted those from TotCat.

Conclusion:

If you truly care about your cats, avoid TotCat at all costs. Their priority is money; they prioritize billing you for their financial gain over the well-being of your pet.

REVIEW UPDATE

September 2025 (MORE THAN A YEAR AFTER MY VISIT TO TOT CAT.)

My cats continue to enjoy good health, and THEIR CANINES REMAIN HEALTHY, SAFE, AND INTACT. Every time I pass by that door, I can't help but remember what mercenaries they were.
Amazing professionals. I wish everyone were as careful as they are. I'm so grateful for the care they gave my cat.
Great professionals and the place where they saved my cat Luna

My kittens ONLY go to Tot Cat, even though we live a bit far away and it would be more convenient to go to another clinic, but they inspire 100% confidence.

While I've had some bad experiences at other clinics, with them everything is transparent, professional, and they have a comprehensive understanding of their patients. They are highly professional, kind, and caring.

If I could, I'd give them more than 5 stars!
It was our first visit and they gave us a wonderful welcome.
The whole team is very professional and the atmosphere is very peaceful.
It was perfect for my cat.
My cat had surgery on her nose because she couldn't breathe properly, and we couldn't be happier with the result! They treated us and her wonderfully! Thank you so much, Alba and Martin! 🐱🌊 …
Excellent professionals and exquisite service

Excellent service, both for pets and their owners.

We've been coming here for years and everything's been great. Martín is fantastic! He's the best feline surgeon I know!

And the rest of the team is phenomenal too! ;-)
There has been a dramatic drop in quality since Martin left. The clinic's attention and professionalism have declined drastically.

A disappointing experience...

After researching online, my partner and I went to them to schedule an appointment with a feline ethologist.

I want to emphasize that we chose this clinic because of their self-description: "At Tot Cat, we specialize in feline medicine and surgery."

Upon arrival, we spoke with a woman who, after we explained our situation (our cat has anxious attachment issues, and our veterinarian recommended we consult an ethologist to address the anxiety-inducing behavior), told us we couldn't schedule an appointment with the ethologist without a consultation.

I explained that I didn't understand why I would have to bring my cat to the clinic twice (which would only increase his anxiety) or pay for a veterinary visit when what I needed was a consultation with the ethologist.

An ethologist, who isn't necessarily a veterinarian, is a specialist in feline behavior. Because, as I mentioned, my cat doesn't have any medical condition.

I told the woman I was a veterinary technician and asked if it was a matter of procedure, if I could provide a signed letter with my veterinarian's registration number. She repeatedly told me it wasn't possible.

I suppose she was feeling overwhelmed because her answers didn't seem very coherent. It was then that she admitted it was an external service of the clinic and that they had to collaborate with them in some way.

This leads me to believe they make these visits so they can monetize the ethology service somehow, not because the patient needs it.

They've completely lost my trust, and obviously we left without scheduling an appointment.
They are very good with cats.

My cat sitter, whom I trust completely, highly recommended Tot Cat to me ash she also brings her own cats here.

So, I brought my cat, Cesi, for a spay surgery and a general check-up.

The staff is incredibly kind and genuinely attentive to both the owner’s input and the cat’s personality and daily behavior. They handled Cesi with great care, and I felt completely at ease—even if I had to leave her at the clinic for the entire day. They even called me during the day to reassure me that everything was going well, which I really appreciated.

After the visit, Cesi was completely fine—she showed no signs of fear or stress, which, to me, speaks volumes about the quality of care she received.

Their pricing is fair and transparent, covering only essential services without unnecessary add-ons.

We’ll definitely be sticking with Tot Cat as Cesi’s vets from now on.

Thank you for your kindness and professionalism!
Good service 🐱 …

Thanks to the whole team, especially Alba, who has been following Simba's progress every step of the way. She's been there every step of the way, and we know she'll continue to be. A million thanks to everyone.

We couldn't be more grateful for the care we received from the entire team, and especially from our cat Picasso's veterinarian, Alba. Alba is a fantastic professional and an even better person!
We went to other clinics for hematuria and kidney problems, where they couldn't help us at all... until our cat reached a critical stage, and thanks to her previous vet, she recommended Totcat.

After several visits and tests, we finally saw the light at the end of the tunnel and were able to extend Picasso's life expectancy. Totcat saved her!
Alba is a sweetheart and has had endless patience answering all our questions throughout this time.
We highly recommend this clinic if you love your pet and want a reputable place where they adore cats and won't try to rip you off.
Now we only trust them.
Thank you again for everything, and we'll see you soon at the next checkup :)

Very attentive to our pet.
They answered all our questions.
Very affordable price.
Excellent service and attention. They know what they're doing.
Great team!! Thank you always!!

I couldn't be happier! They are very professional, especially Martin, who has been the vet treating Tro. Tro has been through a lot and continues to be, and thanks to them, we've extended his life expectancy. We came from Mataró, and I don't regret it at all. I highly recommend their services!

I would not advise anyone to go to this clinic. Insufficient protocol in communication and adequate treatment. Neither Mrs. Alba nor her superior Mr. Martí helped us in any way. Very expensive and very bad experience. Inform yourself well before going🙏🏻 …

I had a very negative experience at this cat clinic. It seems their main focus isn't the animals' well-being, but rather performing unnecessary tests just to increase their revenue. TOTCAT clinic's recommendations seemed more geared towards generating income than caring for my pet's health, and they failed to detect his illness despite multiple tests. I felt pressured into undergoing procedures that were clearly unnecessary, until I found another clinic that actually performed the proper tests. If I had listened to them, I would have had my cat operated on for something he didn't need. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone (Tot cat = MONEY-TAKERS).
Great professionals
Excellent professionals. I've been taking my cat to this clinic for five years now. They are kind and always attentive to the animals and their owners. I highly recommend them.

A Disappointing Experience

Fantastic clinic!!! ❤️

We've taken all four of our cats there, and the care has always been excellent and professional. Especially with one of our cats, Kiara, who is alive thanks to them. Special thanks to Alicia for her professionalism and to the clinic assistants.
The team is very professional.
